result.summary: 本文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，认为不同深度网络对数据的表示正在趋同，并可能收敛到对现实世界的一个共享统计模型 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中跨架构、跨目标、跨模态的表示对齐证据，并用 78 个视觉模型和多个语言模型测量了对齐随规模与性能提升而增强的趋势 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者进一步提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种可能的选择压力来解释这种收敛 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并在理想化世界下证明一类对比学习器会收敛到表示 P(Z) 的 PMI 核 [S4.SS2.p6]。作者也讨论了该假说的局限与反例，包括不同模态可能包含不同信息、并非所有表示目前都在收敛等 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探讨的问题是：不同神经网络模型对数据的表示是否正在趋同，这种趋同是否会持续，以及最终会收敛到什么 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者提出的核心假说是，这种收敛存在一个终点和驱动原则，即不同模型都在试图得到对现实的表示，也就是对生成观测数据的世界事件联合分布的表示 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe

method.text: 作者将表示定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似性结构）来刻画表示，用核对齐度量衡量两个表示的相似性 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验中主要使用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的 k 近邻集合的平均交集除以 k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。跨模态对齐时，作者用成对数据集（如 Wikipedia 图像-标题数据）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核和文本核再测量其对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。此外，作者在理想化世界模型下分析了一类对比学习器，推导其最优解会逼近 PMI 核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
A kernel, $K\colon\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$, characterizes how a representation measures distance/similarity between datapoints.
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels, $K_{1}$ and $K_{2}$, normalized by $k$
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.

Our contrastive learner tries to classify if a pair is positive or negative by learning a representation $f_{X}\colon X\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{d}$ such that the dot-product kernel approximates the log odds ratio up to some offset
Therefore, the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).

experiments.text: 视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了 78 个视觉模型，包括 17 个 ViT、1 个随机初始化 ResNet-50、11 个 ResNet-50 和 49 个 ResNet-18，训练架构、目标和数据集各异 [A3.SS1.p1]。表示质量用 VTAB 的 19 个分类任务上的线性探测评估，对齐度量使用 Places-365 验证集上 1000 个图像表示的 k=10 最近邻 [A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。跨模态方面，作者比较了 BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA 等语言模型与 ImageNet-21K 分类、MAE、DINOv2、CLIP 等视觉模型，在 WIT 的 1024 个样本上计算 k=10 最近邻对齐 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。作者还做了颜色共现案例研究，从 CIFAR-10 像素共现和语言共现中学习颜色表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total:
we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
We mainly consider the popular vision models: classification on ImageNet-21K, MAE, DINOv2, CLIP, and CLIP finetuned on ImageNet-12K.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;)
We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset

findings.text: 在 78 个视觉模型上，VTAB 迁移性能高的模型形成紧密聚集的表示，而性能弱的模型表示更分散 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态上，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然 [S2.SS3.p5]。对齐程度还与下游任务性能相关：与 DINOv2 对齐更好的 LLM 在 Hellaswag 和 GSM8K 上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。在颜色案例中，从图像共现或语言共现学习都能恢复大致相同的感知颜色表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations
the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
The converse effect also holds: the better a vision models is, the more it tends to align with LLMs.
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同传感器和视角可能捕获不同信息，这可能限制它们收敛到完全相同的表示 [S1.p4]。第 4 节的数学论证只严格适用于 Z 的双射投影，对于有损或随机观测函数并不成立 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。作者还指出，目前并非所有表示都在收敛，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表示方式，硬件昂贵且缓慢造成训练数据瓶颈 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，AI 社区的研究者偏见和“硬件彩票”可能推动模型向类人表示收敛 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]；专用智能可能不会收敛，因为其表示可能脱离现实 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。作者也承认对齐度量本身存在争议，且实验中对齐分数只达到 0.16（理论上限为 1），这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: different sensors and views might capture different information, which may limit their potential to converge to identical representations
our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
This will not hold true for either lossy or stochastic observation functions.
in robotics there is not yet a standardized approach to representing world states in the same way as there is for representing images and text
One limitation lies in the hardware used in robotics, which is often expensive and slow.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
the “hardware lottery” suggests that the success of AI models can also depend on the compatibility of their design with available computational architectures
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
for any special purpose there may be shortcuts, or even effective representations detached from reality
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric
We leave this as an open question.
